verdict.rationale: The pack documents generation endpoints, SDKs, per-endpoint OpenAPI definitions on the legacy reference, and a versioned /v1 API. None of it mentions webhook or callback registration, a get-generation status endpoint, or job states such as completed or failed. Without evidence of either a completion webhook or a documented pollable job status, this applicable capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, my system learns a render finished or failed through a webhook or a documented pollable job status
